title: The Little Brother — EN/FR/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar French German language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual family portrait Zimbabwe-Australia character
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
He figured things out quietly.
He came home different. Joel and Kerri.
The room had already decided.
The little brother did exactly right.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Il résolvait les choses tranquillement. (He figured things out quietly.)
Il est rentré différent. Joel et Kerri. (He came home different. Joel and Kerri.)
La pièce avait déjà décidé. (The room had already decided.)
Le petit frère a fait exactement la bonne chose. (The little brother did exactly right.)
Le petit frère (The little brother)
Qui s'est avéré être celui qui savait. (Who turned out to be the one who knew.)
Joel — qui a compris avant d'expliquer. (Joel — who understood before he explained it.)
Bien joué. (Good one.)

[Chorus - German, with English translations]
Der kleine Bruder (The little brother)
Der sich herausstellte, derjenige zu sein, der es wusste (Who turned out to be the one who knew)
Der kleine Bruder (The little brother)
Der Simbabwe in Australien fand (Who found Zimbabwe in Australia)
Joel — der verstand, bevor er erklärte (Joel — who understood before he explained it)
Joel — der anders nach Hause kam (Joel — who came home different)
Der kleine Bruder (The little brother)
Hat genau das Richtige getan (Did exactly right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Jeff and Jill flew over. Everyone stood in a kitchen. It was immediately obvious.
French: Jeff et Jill ont volé. Tout le monde se tenait dans une cuisine. C'était immédiatement évident. (Jeff and Jill flew over. Everyone in a kitchen. Immediately obvious.)
German: Jeff und Jill flogen herüber. Alle standen in einer Küche. Es war sofort offensichtlich. (Jeff and Jill flew over. Everyone in a kitchen. Immediately obvious.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Good one. Little brother.
French: Bien joué. Petit frère. (Good one. Little brother.)
German: Gut gemacht. Kleiner Bruder. (Good one. Little brother.)
